Local trial · 13 October 2026 · macOS ARM64 · OfficeCLI 1.0.157

OfficeCLI evaluation for WeChat DOCX

Use OfficeCLI for document inspection and targeted edits. Keep the current Markdown exporter and LibreOffice layout review.

OfficeCLI preserved the FlashAttention article in this trial and exposed structural defects that our current checks miss. Replacing the exporter would still require our Markdown parsing, inline math conversion, and equation/code image generation. The trial does not establish lower maintenance for that replacement.

1. What was tested

The input was the reviewed Chinese article 理解 FlashAttention and its existing DOCX and manifest. All mutations used disposable copies. The production converter, approved Markdown, stored DOCX, and skills were unchanged. No global OfficeCLI or skill installation was performed.

  1. Inspect: read document structure and formatting, then run OfficeCLI's schema validation.
  2. Edit: remove native script formatting and quote backgrounds from a copy, confirm our checker fails, and restore the properties with OfficeCLI.
  3. Create: export OfficeCLI's document command list, create a blank DOCX, and replay the list with batch. This tests DOCX reconstruction, not Markdown import.
  4. Compare: check source text, inline formatting, image data, links, and page pixels; inspect every distinct rendered page.

All measurements below come from the embedded trial evidence. They describe this document and environment.

3. Rendering without WPS

Our final layout check uses the managed render_docx.py wrapper with LibreOffice headless: DOCX → PDF → page PNGs. It runs locally without WPS. LibreOffice documents its --headless and --convert-to options in the official command-line guide.

OfficeCLI's view html also gives a local preview that opens in a browser. It is useful for inspection. In this trial it placed the “4. Attention” heading at the bottom of a page and moved its equation to the next page. Keep an independent document renderer for acceptance. See the OfficeCLI preview documentation.

Compare inline math and quote highlighting
Compare heading placement and pagination

4. What this changes

  1. Worth using: OfficeCLI gives convenient structured inspection, localized formatting edits, and an independent schema validator. The current exporter remains the simplest tested route from our reviewed Markdown.
  2. Follow-up fix identified: make shading attributes explicit and assign unique drawing/bookmark IDs in the existing exporter. OfficeCLI also reported unresolved style references; review those separately. These defects are recorded here and were not changed as part of this isolated trial.
  3. Keep workflow-specific review: OfficeCLI's generic validation cannot establish that inline math is editable text, display math/code are PNGs, quote colors follow our rules, or the document matches the approved Markdown. Retain review-wechat-docx.
  4. Keep the migration decision separate: no Markdown-to-OfficeCLI adapter was built. The successful reconstruction reused the existing export's content, images, and formatting. It does not measure the effort to implement that adapter.

Limits: this was a local FlashAttention trial. Microsoft Word, WPS, and WeChat paste/save/reopen were not tested. The article covers red/yellow quotes; a new gray quote was not added. Runtime timings in the evidence are diagnostic observations, not a performance benchmark.

5. Reproduce the trial

Download the matching executable from the official release and verify its SHA256 against the release metadata. The trial used the macOS ARM64 binary, without running its installer. The repository script requires Python with lxml; the managed document runtime already includes it.

doc_runtime="${CODEX_DOCUMENT_RUNTIME:-$HOME/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime}"
"$doc_runtime/dependencies/python/bin/python3" \
  scripts/experiments/officecli-wechat-trial.py \
  --officecli /path/to/officecli \
  --output /tmp/officecli-new-trial

The output directory must be new. The script disables automatic resident processes, saves command output and results, and produces disposable edited/recreated documents plus HTML previews. Render the baseline and both outputs with the same render_docx.py, font configuration, and page settings before comparing pixels. On this Mac, the render configuration included /System/Library/Fonts and the managed LibreOffice fonts. OfficeCLI's documentation describes the batch and resident-mode behavior.

# Useful inspection commands; explicitly disable background resident mode.
OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_RESIDENT=1 officecli validate article.docx --json
OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_RESIDENT=1 officecli view article.docx annotated --json
OFFICECLI_NO_AUTO_RESIDENT=1 officecli view article.docx html > preview.html

6. Trial evidence

The embedded data records source and binary hashes, command results, workflow checks, preservation comparisons, and per-page pixel differences. A null difference bounding box means no changed pixel. The render job completed successfully and its output files were verified. The reproducible command script was rerun and returned the same pass/fail outcomes.
